title: Complimenting a Nice Hand After Showdown
summaryJa: ショーダウン後、相手の上手なプレーを褒めるという自然な会話です。ポーカーテーブルでの礼儀正しい交流を学べます。対戦相手との良好な関係を築くために、英語で相手を認める表現が実用的です。
segments: You: Nice hand. Good read on me there.
Opponent: Thanks, man. You played it well too—I almost folded.
You: That river card could have gone either way.
Opponent: Yeah, it was close. Good luck with the rest of your tournament.
You: You too. Thanks for the game.
